programme.title: Bizarre Foods: Delicious Destinations
programme.desc: 'S6/E10 - Savannah'. Andrew Zimmern dives into the flavour-packed favourites of Savannah, Georgia, like creamy shrimp and grits, briny oysters in a half shell, and upscale crab bisque.

programme.title: Chopped
programme.desc: 'S54/E6 - Casino Royale XL: Grand Finale'. The champions are back, and they're chasing a jackpot that starts at $25,000! They face shocking ingredient in their appetiser basket.

programme.title: Chopped
programme.desc: 'S60/E12 - Raclette Racket'. Four brave chefs take on a cheese that won't melt and a clock that won't stop! Then, the chefs step it up in the entrée round with camel tenderloin.

programme.title: Summer Baking Championship
programme.desc: 'S1/E7 - Sweets For Barbie'. Jesse Palmer celebrates Warner Bros. Pictures' movie event, Barbie! He challenges the bakers to make desserts inspired by Barbie's signature colour, pink!

programme.title: Holiday Wars
programme.desc: 'S4/E5 - Ugly Sweater Party'. Host Jeff Mauro challenges the five remaining teams to create a woodland creature who is throwing an ugly sweater party for all their forest friends.

programme.title: The Kitchen
programme.desc: 'S35/E3 - Turkey Day Mashups'. The hosts go big on Thanksgiving flavours with holiday mashups, like spinach artichoke dip stuffed mushrooms, pecan pie brownie bars and more!

programme.title: Kids Baking Championship
programme.desc: 'S8/E1 - Beyond The Fringe'. Valerie Bertinelli and Duff Goldman go back to the 1970s as they challenge the 12 young bakers to make cakes in their chosen flavour inspired by a shag carpet!

programme.title: Restaurant Impossible: Last Call
programme.desc: 'S1/E4 - Family Heat'. A Mexican restaurant suffocates under debt and a matriarch clinging to outworn ideas while her chef son is trying to save his mother's life's work.

programme.title: Restaurant Impossible: Last Call
programme.desc: 'S1/E5 - A Spicy Affair'. The owner of an award-winning Indian restaurant is afraid to face the truth of a silent dining room and mounting bills.

programme.title: Restaurant Impossible: Last Call
programme.desc: 'S1/E6 - Caviar Dreams'. An over-confident young chef with high-end ambitions for his French restaurant must face the realities of running a business.

programme.title: Bizarre Foods With Andrew Zimmern
programme.desc: 'S6/E6 - Panama Beef Lungs And Love Potions'. Andrew Zimmern heads to Panama City, one of the world's crossroads. He feasts on chicken foot souse before hitting the streets for beef lung and aphrodisiac smoothies.

programme.title: Man Fire Food
programme.desc: 'S4/E1 - Pigging Out On Pork'. One of the great wonders of the barbecue world is smoked pork shoulder. It's a big hunk of meat cooked low and slow until succulent and tender. Roger's favourite way to devour this is in a sandwich.

programme.title: Man Fire Food
programme.desc: 'S4/E2 - Alabama BBQ'. The American Barbecue Belt stretches from the Carolinas to Texas, and today Roger heads to the heart of it - Alabama.

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins, And Dives
programme.desc: 'S35/E13 - From Chicken To Chiles'. Guy Fieri finds all kinds of unexpected flavour with next-level sandwiches in Cleveland with Chef Michael Symon. And in NJ, a joint is amping up bar bites.

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins, And Dives
programme.desc: 'S35/E14 - Cruisin' Coast To Coast'. Guy Fieri digs into flavour coast to coast, starting at a taco joint in Indio, California, with a next level quesadilla-taco-au jus mashup.

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins, And Dives
programme.desc: 'S35/E15 - Stellar Sandwiches And Big-Time Burgers'. Guy Fieri unhinges his jaw for some stellar sandwiches and big-time burgers. In Palm Desert, CA, a market-deli piles up the porchetta.

programme.title: Bizarre Foods: Delicious Destinations
programme.desc: 'S3/E6 - Singapore'. Andrew explores Singapore's famous foods. The cuisine reflects its blend of cultures with dishes like sweet and savoury chili crab, fish head curry and satay.

programme.title: Bizarre Foods: Delicious Destinations
programme.desc: 'S6/E11 - Jerusalem'. From savoury classics like shawarma, falafel, kubbeh and hummus to tempting pastries like halva and bureka, Jerusalem's edible icons are steeped in history.

programme.title: Bizarre Foods: Delicious Destinations
programme.desc: 'S6/E12 - Amman'. Andrew samples some of the dishes of Amman, Jordan, such as multi-tiered towers of goat and veggies, sumac-coated chicken with onions and lamb cooked in creamy yogurt sauce.

programme.title: Chopped
